rv.q: You still had a feeling that this was something you perhaps had no right to be watching.
The performance could charitably be called eccentric, but it's more to the point to say it's simply dreadful.
It's hardly much of anything, though apparently it was good enough for the people involved.

cn.t: Critics are sharply divided on this star-studded production, with praise for an effectively seductive dance sequence overshadowed by complaints that the staging renders Wilde's exotic drama silly and lifeless.

vs.sum: The Ethel Barrymore Theatre offers good sightlines with a well-raked mezzanine and minimal obstructions, though some box seats have limited views. Sound quality is average, with some reports of less than ideal acoustics. Comfort is typical for a Broadway theater, with decent legroom in some areas. However, facilities are lacking, with only one restroom on the lower level leading to potential congestion.

acc.note: 5 wheelchair spaces in Orchestra. No steps from sidewalk. Infrared devices available.
